definitions.time_to_fall_s: Free mode only: sim time at fall_step (base_z < 0.4 m or |roll|/|pitch| > 45 deg); null if no fall or kin_root mode. Not comparable across solver settings (e.g. pass3 jump free 0.55 s at 8 substeps + scratch motion vs 6C 0.97 s at 1 substep + retargeted motion); see sim_settings in metrics JSON.
definitions.joint_rmse_rad: RMS over time and joints of |q - q_ref| (GMR 29-DoF order). Free mode: only steps t <= fall_step (inclusive); kin_root: full clip.
definitions.root_pos_err_cm_mean: Mean L2 distance (cm) between sim root_pos and root_pos_ref. Free mode: truncated at fall_step; kin_root: full clip.
definitions.root_pos_err_cm_p95: 95th percentile of per-step root position error (cm); same truncation as mean.
definitions.root_rot_err_deg_mean: Mean geodesic angle (deg) between sim and ref root quaternions (xyzw); same truncation as root pos.
definitions.pd_demand_exceeds_limit_{legs,waist,arms: Per actuator group (12 legs / 3 waist / 14 arms GMR indices): fraction of steps where ANY joint in the group has |tau_pd|/effort_limit >= 0.95. tau_pd is the logged analytic PD demand K*(q*-q)-D*qdot (same as Isaac computed_torque before clip).
definitions.pd_demand_ratio_{legs,waist,arms}_step_m: 95th percentile of per-step max_j |tau_pd|/limit within the group.
definitions.actuator_torque_at_limit_{legs,waist,arm: Per group: fraction of steps where ANY joint has |tau_applied|/effort_limit >= 0.95 (Isaac applied_torque after actuator clipping). Null if run .npz has no tau_applied_gmr.
definitions.actuator_clamped_pd_demand_{legs,waist,a: Per group: fraction of steps where ANY joint has |tau_computed| > |tau_applied| + 1e-3 N·m (PD demand was clipped by the actuator model). Null without tau_applied_gmr.
definitions.deprecated_pooled_all29_pd_demand_step_f: DEPRECATED headline: any-of-29-joints PD demand step rate (was 0.380 on ACCAD jump kin_root); dominated by unclipped waist ImplicitActuator PD vs limit — use per-group pd_demand_* instead.
definitions.torque_saturation_joint_step_fraction: Fraction of (step, joint) pairs over 29 GMR joints with |tau_pd|/effort_limit >= 0.95.
definitions.foot_slip_rms_m_s: EXPERIMENTAL, NOT INTERPRETED: contact-aware slip on simulated ankle positions at sim dt; reference vs sim contact sample counts differ widely (e.g. walk 106 vs 3032). Do not use as evidence.
definitions.foot_slip_contact_frames: EXPERIMENTAL: count of (step, foot) velocity samples in foot_slip_rms_m_s; not interpreted.
definitions.sim_settings: Physics/control metadata: dt, num_substeps, njmax, nconmax, initial_root_velocity_convention.
definitions.assist_wrench: Not reported — not available on this Newton path (see pivot_log).

assist_wrench_note: Not reported — not available on this Newton path (see pivot_log).

sim_settings.initial_root_velocity_convention: zero at spawn (write_root_velocity not called at init); kin_root mode overwrites root pose+velocity from motion reference each step
